//functionTimeout: Consumption (Y1) defaults to 5 minutes and caps at 10. The expiry timer fires every 5 minutes and one removal can poll a long-running ARM operation for 180-300s, so the default allowed a run to be killed mid-row. Remove-ExpiredRules stops itself at ~80% of this (JIT_CLEANUP_BUDGET_SECONDS) and logs what it deferred.

applicationInsights.//samplingSettings: Exception telemetry is excluded from sampling because the two escalations that must never be lost - JITOrphanedGrant (a live rule nothing tracks) and JITRemoveStuck (a hole that will not close) - are raised with Write-Error and arrive as exceptions. Traces are deliberately NOT excluded: every Write-Host would be exempted, at real cost. The durable record of grants and revocations is the JITRulesAudit table, which Application Insights sampling cannot touch.
